tokens.name: theme-page
tokens.usage: App page ground behind every surface. theme-text reads 14.95:1 on it.

tokens.name: theme-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, sidebar, inputs. The most used token in the app.

tokens.name: theme-surface-soft
tokens.usage: One step off white for quiet zones inside a surface (headers, side strips).

tokens.name: theme-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the white dismiss button and other neutral hovers.

tokens.name: theme-text
tokens.usage: Headings and strong labels on theme-surface (16.4:1) and theme-page.

tokens.name: theme-text-body
tokens.usage: Default body copy; set on :root. 15.6:1 on theme-surface.

tokens.name: theme-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on theme-surface (5.07:1) and theme-page (4.63:1). Misses AA on theme-selected (4.39:1): use theme-muted-strong there.

tokens.name: theme-muted-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary text on tinted grounds where theme-muted misses AA: theme-selected 4.81:1, theme-warning-soft 5.20:1.

tokens.name: theme-border
tokens.usage: The edge of a box (card, panel, table). Decorative, 1.30:1; separate from theme-border-subtle on purpose (BL-216).

tokens.name: theme-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and sections inside a box. Never a box edge.

tokens.name: theme-border-strong
tokens.usage: A heavier box edge where theme-border disappears on a tinted ground.

tokens.name: theme-accent
tokens.usage: Brand green. Fill of the green action button (nf-button, Settings header Save), selected marks; text on white 6.59:1; white text on it 6.59:1.

tokens.name: theme-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Darker brand green: hover of the green action button, the NEWFORK wordmark on pre-workspace screens, pressed and emphasized accents. 7.28:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row or item fill. Text on it: theme-text or theme-muted-strong, never theme-muted.

tokens.name: theme-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset on buttons, links and selects. 5.24:1 on white, 4.80:1 on theme-page.

tokens.name: theme-action
tokens.usage: Near-black fill of the Schedule top-bar actions (Export, Templates, New Schedule, and Publish while nothing is live), via schedule-action. Kept black by Mert's choice on 2026-10-04 (KARARLAR, Schedule); everywhere else actions are green (UI-09).

tokens.name: theme-action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of theme-action.

tokens.name: theme-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and error text and marks. 5.43:1 on white, 4.90:1 on theme-danger-soft.

tokens.name: theme-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and destructive zone fill.

tokens.name: theme-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and the warning toast icon. 5.93:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner fill. Secondary text on it: theme-muted-strong.

tokens.name: theme-success
tokens.usage: Success text and marks. 6.46:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-success-soft
tokens.usage: Success fill. Same value as theme-selected (merge pending, THEME-003).

tokens.name: theme-current
tokens.usage: The 'now' marker: current day ring on Schedule (via schedule-current-ring-color). 3.64:1 on white: marks only, never body text.

tokens.name: theme-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on theme-accent and the green button fills.

tokens.name: theme-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on Account screens (BL-148). 6.64:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-text-menu
tokens.usage: Menu item text on Account screens. 12.86:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft green tint behind accent marks (Account screens).

tokens.name: theme-accent-deep
tokens.usage: Text of the white dismiss button (secondary-button). 9.65:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-focus-halo
tokens.usage: Soft halo around a focused field. Decorative only (1.29:1): the ring itself is theme-focus.

tokens.name: theme-border-hover
tokens.usage: Control edge on hover. 2.46:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-warning-surface
tokens.usage: Warning panel ground (Account screens).

tokens.name: theme-warning-border
tokens.usage: Warning panel edge.

tokens.name: theme-warning-text
tokens.usage: Text on theme-warning-surface, 7.93:1.

tokens.name: theme-danger-surface
tokens.usage: Danger panel ground (Account screens).

tokens.name: theme-danger-border
tokens.usage: Danger panel edge.

tokens.name: theme-danger-text
tokens.usage: Text on theme-danger-soft, 8.49:1.

tokens.name: theme-danger-strong
tokens.usage: Strong destructive text and marks. 6.59:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-availability
tokens.usage: Schedule: an employee's availability preference the manager may still schedule over (orange = warn, G14). 3.28:1 on white: marks and hatches only, with the 18px '!' circle.

tokens.name: theme-availability-soft
tokens.usage: Availability cell fill, hatched 135° with rgba(217,115,13,.26).

tokens.name: theme-time-off
tokens.usage: Schedule: approved time off, a block (red, G14). 5.32:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-time-off-soft
tokens.usage: Time-off cell fill, hatched 135° with rgba(212,22,42,.32).

tokens.name: theme-accent-focus
tokens.usage: Focus mark on accent-tinted controls.

tokens.name: theme-published
tokens.usage: Schedule publication: the whole week is live (BL-312). 5.00:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-published-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of theme-published.

tokens.name: theme-published-partial
tokens.usage: Schedule publication: only some locations are live. 5.02:1 on white.

tokens.name: theme-published-partial-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of theme-published-partial.

tokens.name: theme-border-control
tokens.usage: The edge every Schedule top-bar control shares. 2.02:1 on white: misses the 3:1 control floor (BL-450), kept exact.

tokens.name: theme-swatch-fallback
tokens.usage: Dot of a location or chip of a person with no colour of its own.

tokens.name: theme-swatch-fallback-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill of the fallback swatch.

tokens.name: theme-note
tokens.usage: Reserved for a manager's note on a Schedule shift (the 11px corner and the note card rule). Never a status, warning or selection. 7.59:1 on white.

tokens.name: schedule-action
tokens.usage: Schedule top-bar action fill.

tokens.name: schedule-action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of schedule-action.

tokens.name: schedule-grid-line-color
tokens.usage: Schedule grid cell lines.

tokens.name: schedule-section-line-color
tokens.usage: Line between Schedule sections (departments, locations). 2.75:1 on white.

tokens.name: schedule-unassigned-row-background
tokens.usage: The Unassigned row on Schedule. theme-muted reads 4.55:1 on it.

tokens.name: schedule-unassigned-line-color
tokens.usage: The 2px rule that marks the Unassigned row.

tokens.name: schedule-focus-ring-color
tokens.usage: Focus ring on Schedule cells and shift cards.

tokens.name: schedule-current-ring-color
tokens.usage: Ring on today's column.

tokens.name: schedule-ghost-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of a ghost shift card (an employee's shift at another location): one switched-off grey for every ghost.

tokens.name: schedule-ghost-text
tokens.usage: Text of a ghost shift card. 6.44:1 on white.

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, in the page header (.page-header h1).

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Text of nf-button. Inherits the 16px root size.

styles.name: ui-dense
styles.usage: Dense UI text: Style B windows, menus, table cells. Most used size after 12px.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.usage: Meta lines, shift card details, labels. The most used literal size in the app.

styles.name: ui-micro
styles.usage: Badges and grid captions. Smallest size used for words.

styles.name: time-input
styles.usage: Time inputs, so digits line up.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name in capitals, theme-accent-strong, on pre-workspace and public pages.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above a page title, colour #9b3e28 (6.75:1 on white).

spacing.note: The app has no global spacing scale yet; these are the Schedule grid's own steps.

tokens.name: schedule-cell-edit-inset
tokens.usage: Inset of a shift card inside its cell while editing.

tokens.name: schedule-cell-preview-inset
tokens.usage: Inset of a shift card in preview.

tokens.name: schedule-badge-edit-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked shift cards while editing.

tokens.name: schedule-badge-preview-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked shift cards in preview.

tokens.name: schedule-add-shift-lane-height
tokens.usage: Height of the add-shift lane at the bottom of a cell.

radius.note: No global radius tokens yet. In use: 6px buttons and inputs, 8px toasts, 4px shift badges.

tokens.name: schedule-badge-radius
tokens.usage: Shift cards and badges on Schedule.

borderWidth.note: Line weights the Schedule grid names.

tokens.name: schedule-grid-line-width
tokens.usage: Grid cell lines.

tokens.name: schedule-unassigned-line-width
tokens.usage: Rule under the Unassigned row.

tokens.name: schedule-location-boundary-width
tokens.usage: Boundary between locations in the grid.
